observations: Sony PlayStation 5 Slim console shown vertically in photo 0.
Light blue DualSense wireless controller placed on top of the console in photo 0.
Original retail box for a PS5 Slim visible in photos 0 and 2.
Watermark 'JAYCYPHER GAMES' appears on all three photos.
An invoice from 'JAY CYPHER GAMES & DIGITALS' is shown in photos 1 and 2.
The invoice date in photo 1 and 2 appears to be '19/04/2025'.
The invoice in photo 2 specifies model 'CFI-2016' and a serial number.
The seller's text claims the item is 'Brand new' but also '9days used'.

claims.evidence: The seller later states it is '9days used', and the console is shown out of the box.
Usage time cannot be confirmed through photos.
Only the console, one controller, and box are shown; cables and stand are not visible.
A receipt is shown in photos 1 and 2, though its authenticity is highly suspect.
Photo 0 shows the console in very clean condition with no visible scuffs.

risks.proof: A video of the seller holding the console while saying the buyer's name and today's date.
A clear, high-resolution photo of the receipt showing a valid current or past date rather than a future one.
risks.if_unproven: as having no warranty or proof of purchase

risks.proof: A video showing the console successfully connecting to the PSN Store.
A video showing the console loading and playing a game for 10 minutes.

proof_requests: Video of the seller holding the console and a handwritten note with the current date and buyer's name.
Video of the console booting up, connecting to the internet, and launching a game.
Clear photo of the serial number on the console to match the receipt.
response.reason: The photos carry a professional business watermark ('JAYCYPHER GAMES') while the seller's text implies a private resale, suggesting the photos may be stolen. Additionally, the receipt date in photos 1 and 2 is '19/04/2025', which is a future date, indicating the document is likely forged.
